notes: The MAX and MAX PLUS TFT editions share one USB identity (product string "AK820 MAX") and one official driver package; firmware does not report which edition it is.

usb.evidence: Official driver config.xml mode 0 (VID 0C45, PID 8009/800A); hardware topology on the test unit.

2.4ghz.evidence: Official driver config.xml mode 2 (dongles 05AC:024F and 0C45:FDFD) and menu_wireless (no screen). Dongle protocol differs (32-byte output reports); not yet verified on hardware.

bluetooth.evidence: Official driver message 62: keyboard settings are not supported in Bluetooth mode.

knob.note: No knob/wheel remapping exists in the official driver for this model.
